name: flatmark
description:
Document to Markdown API and MCP server for PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and HTML. OCR queue for large files. Hosted in Germany.

Base URL: `https://api.flatmark.dev`.

### Authentication
Send your key in the `X-API-Key` header. Calls without a key run anonymously at
a lower rate limit per IP address.

### Rate limits
Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and
`X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the window resets). Over-budget calls return
`429` with a `Retry-After` header. Check your live budget at `GET /v1/me`.

### Pagination
List endpoints return a keyset envelope: `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`.
Pass `next_cursor` back as the `?cursor=` query param for the next page; it is
`null` on the last page.

### Errors
Errors are [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `problem+json` with a
stable machine-readable **`code`** (e.g. `rate_limited`, `credits_exhausted`,
`validation_error`). Branch on `code`. The `title` and `detail` text may change.

### Quickstart
```sh
curl -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" https://api.flatmark.dev/v1/me
```
